deduplicateUrls.description: Emit each page URL once even when it appears in several sitemaps. Turn off to keep one row per sitemap listing.
deduplicateUrls.title: Remove duplicate URLs

discoverSitemaps.description: When the input is a domain or homepage, read robots.txt, the homepage <link rel="sitemap"> hint, common sitemap paths and—when no sitemap is advertised—the homepage's RSS/Atom autodiscovery links. Turn off to read only the exact URLs you supplied.
discoverSitemaps.title: Find sitemaps automatically

followSitemapIndexes.description: When a sitemap index points to child sitemaps, fetch and merge them. Turn off to read only the sitemap files you supplied and stop at any index.
followSitemapIndexes.title: Follow sitemap indexes

includeAlternates.description: Add the xhtml:link hreflang alternates attached to a URL, including x-default, even when the sitemap uses a legacy xhtml namespace.
includeAlternates.title: Include hreflang alternates

includeImages.description: Add the image sitemap entries attached to a URL (location, title, caption, license, geo location).
includeImages.title: Include image metadata

includeNews.description: Add the Google News entries attached to a URL: publication name and language, publication date, headline, genres, keywords and stock tickers.
includeNews.title: Include Google News metadata

includeVideos.description: Add the video sitemap entries attached to a URL, including thumbnail, player/content URLs, duration, dates, tags, categories, ratings, restrictions and live status.
includeVideos.title: Include video metadata

keepUrlsWithoutLastmod.description: When a date filter is set, also keep URLs and feed items that carry no usable date. Without this, undated entries are dropped by the date filter.
keepUrlsWithoutLastmod.title: Keep URLs without a date

lastmodAfter.description: Keep URLs whose lastmod, feed date or news publication date is on or after this point. Use an ISO date (2026-01-01), a full timestamp, or a relative window such as "7 days", "24 hours" or "2 weeks". Leave blank to keep every URL.
lastmodAfter.title: Only URLs modified on or after

maxSitemapDepth.description: How many levels of nested sitemap indexes to follow. 0 reads only the supplied sitemaps, 1 follows one index level, and so on.
maxSitemapDepth.title: Maximum sitemap-index depth

maxSitemaps.description: Stop after attempting this many sitemap files (indexes and child sitemaps both count). Protects very large sitemap trees such as newspaper archives.
maxSitemaps.title: Maximum sitemap files

maxUrls.description: Total URL rows to emit across all inputs. Set to 0 for no limit. Filtered and duplicate URLs do not count toward this cap.
maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs

sameHostOnly.description: Drop URLs whose hostname differs from the host of your input URLs. Useful when a sitemap includes CDN or alternate-domain pages you do not want.
sameHostOnly.title: Only URLs on the input host

startUrls.description: One or more URLs. Accepts a sitemap, sitemap index, .xml.gz file, sitemap.txt, RSS/Atom feed, robots.txt URL, bare domain (example.com) or homepage. With discovery on, site URLs are resolved through robots.txt, the homepage's sitemap link and common sitemap paths.
startUrls.title: Sitemap, site or feed URLs

urlFilterExclude.description: Drop URLs that match this pattern, applied after the include filter. Uses the same URL match mode.
urlFilterExclude.title: URLs matching (exclude filter)

urlFilterInclude.description: Keep only URLs that match this pattern. Interpretation depends on URL match mode: a regular expression, a plain-text substring, or a wildcard pattern. Leave blank to keep every URL.
urlFilterInclude.title: URLs matching (include filter)

urlMatchMode.description: How the include and exclude filters are interpreted. Regular expressions are case-insensitive. Plain text matches a literal substring. Wildcards use * for any characters except /, ** for any characters including /, and ? for one character.
urlMatchMode.title: URL filter mode
